faqs.question: Do you design bathroom remodels and new builds?
faqs.answer: Yes. We plan the layout and choose tile, vanity, fixtures, lighting, mirrors and color, then style the finished room. A licensed contractor or your builder does the construction. Jody Wallace has led the interior design of four Street of Dreams homes alongside their builders.

faqs.question: How much does bathroom design cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on the scope, from a single consultation to full-service design. We quote after the discovery call. Our guide to [what an interior designer costs in Portland](/blog/interior-designer-cost-portland) explains how designers usually charge.

faqs.question: Do I have room for a double vanity?
faqs.answer: The NKBA's bath planning guidelines call for at least 36″ between the two sink centers and 20″ from each sink center to a side wall. We check those against your actual room before you order a vanity.

faqs.question: Should I choose a tub or a walk-in shower?
faqs.answer: It depends on who uses the room. A walk-in shower suits quick daily use and easier access; the NKBA recommends at least 36″ × 36″ inside. A tub suits soaking and bathing small kids. We help you weigh it room by room.

faqs.question: What should I have ready for the discovery call?
faqs.answer: A few phone photos of the bathroom, rough measurements if you have them, and what bothers you about it now. That's enough to talk through what's possible.

factChecks.quote: The clear opening of a doorway should be at least 32″ (813 mm).

factChecks.claim: 30″ clear floor in front of fixtures
factChecks.quote: Plan a clear floor space of at least 30″ (762 mm) from the front edge of all fixtures (e.g., lavatory, toilet, bidet, tub, and shower) to any opposite bath fixture, wall, or obstacle.
The distance from the centerline of toilet and/or bidet to any bath fixture, wall, or other obstacle should be at least 18″ (457 mm).
A minimum distance of 15″ (381 mm) is required from the centerline of toilet and/or bidet to any bath fixture, wall, or other obstacle.
The distance from the centerline of the lavatory to the sidewall/tall obstacle should be at least 20″ (508 mm).
The distance between the centerlines of two lavatories should be at least 36″ (914 mm).
The height for a lavatory varies between 32″ and 43″ (813 mm and 1092 mm) to fit the user.
The interior shower size is at least 36″ × 36″ (914 mm × 914 mm).
The size for a separate toilet compartment should be at least 36″ × 66″ (914 mm × 1676 mm) with a swing-out or pocket door.
